description: Defaults baked into the m365-claude-relay image. scopes: the default Graph scope list (operators set MS365_MCP_ALLOWED_SCOPES; Softeria's --allowed-scopes derives the tool surface from it at every start). excludedTools: tools not registered because the relay has a better replacement: base64 file reads (get-download-url), base64 and upload-session attachment writes (get-upload-url), and graph-batch, a raw Graph call that would bypass those exclusions. Nothing is withheld for any other reason: what an organisation does not want is Blocked in Claude's per-tool permissions.
